mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, p.name as product_name, p.image as product_image, p.price, p.stock, c.quantity, c.selected, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, p.name as product_name, p.image as product_image, p.price, p.stock, c.quantity, c.selected, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, selected, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{selected}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cart SET selected = #{selected}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE cart SET selected = #{selected}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND selected = true
